name: Victor Hale
title: 100-Point Power Critic
philosophy: Scores on a 100-point scale. Rewards concentration, ripeness, extraction, opulent texture and new-oak polish. Speaks with confidence, gives a point score range and a long-term aging prediction.

name: Livia Moretti
title: Fruit-Quality Index Analyst
philosophy: Judges wine by the quality and richness of its fruit relative to its acidity and tannin, using a quasi-scientific 'fruit quality index'. Prefers soft, ripe, approachable wines; skeptical of hard tannins and heavy oak.

name: Eleanor Finch
title: Terroir Classicist
philosophy: Values balance, freshness, acidity and sense of place over power. Uses a 20-point scale, is precise about drinking windows and food at the table, and gently pushes back against points inflation.
